name: B10-0179/2024 (Renew) – Georgia's worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Georgia’s worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
part_text:
The European Parliament says the October 2024 parliamentary elections in Georgia were not free and fair. It refuses to recognise the results and asks for new elections under international supervision within a year. It also calls for a full investigation into the reported violations, for European Union money to the Georgian government to be frozen, and for sanctions on Georgian leaders. The text is the Parliament's position and demands; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament demands new elections, frozen funding and sanctions.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, its leaders and its voters.
- **What happens next:** The demands go to European Union bodies and Georgia's government.
